queries.query: WITH value_range AS ( SELECT ts_id, MIN(ts_date) AS first_date, MAX(ts_date) AS last_date FROM ts_values_15min GROUP BY ts_id UNION ALL SELECT ts_id, MIN(ts_date), MAX(ts_date) FROM ts_values_1h GROUP BY ts_id UNION ALL SELECT ts_id, MIN(ts_date), MAX(ts_date) FROM ts_values_day GROUP BY ts_id UNION ALL SELECT ts_id, MIN(ts_date), MAX(ts_date) FROM ts_values_month GROUP BY ts_id UNION ALL SELECT ts_id, (MIN(ts_year)::text || '-01-01')::date, (MAX(ts_year)::text || '-01-01')::date FROM ts_values_year GROUP BY ts_id ) SELECT h.ts_id, h.ts_key, CASE h.time_dim WHEN 1 THEN '15 Minuten' WHEN 2 THEN '1 Stunde' WHEN 3 THEN 'Tag' WHEN 4 THEN 'Monat' WHEN 5 THEN 'Jahr' END AS dimension, u.symbol, c.iso_code, o.object_key, h.description, vr.first_date, vr.last_date, h.created_at, h.updated_at FROM ts_header h JOIN ts_unit u ON u.unit_id = h.unit_id LEFT JOIN ts_currency c ON c.currency_id = h.currency_id LEFT JOIN ts_object o ON o.object_id = h.object_id LEFT JOIN value_range vr ON vr.ts_id = h.ts_id ORDER BY h.ts_key
